Bug_Title: python -m osdagbridge.desktop fails with No module named osdagbridge.desktop.__main__
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Install official application via pip install -e . 2. Run launch command python -m osdagbridge.desktop
Expected_Result: Desktop application window should launch cleanly or provide __main__ bootstrap script.
Actual_Result: Fails immediately with: No module named osdagbridge.desktop.__main__; osdagbridge.desktop is a package and cannot be directly executed.

Bug_Title: Desktop bootstrap main.py is an unlinked console stub instead of initializing PySide6 GUI
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Import osdagbridge.desktop.main. 2. Execute main.start(). 3. Observe behavior.
Expected_Result: Should instantiate QApplication and display OsdagBridge desktop interface.
Actual_Result: Prints only Starting desktop UI (stub) to stdout without initiating any graphical window.

Bug_Title: Preliminary sizing routine returns raw DTO string instead of calculated girder depth
Expected_Result: Should calculate preliminary depth based on span-to-depth ratio (Span/12 to Span/15).
Actual_Result: Returns literal string dict {'depth_m': dto.name} bypassing numerical structural evaluation.

Bug_Title: Zero web thickness in girder section produces unhandled ZeroDivisionError in slenderness calculation
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Construct girder section. 2. Set web_thickness = 0.0 mm. 3. Trigger slenderness ratio check.
Expected_Result: Input validator should catch non-positive thickness with ERR_NEGATIVE_OR_ZERO_INPUT.
Actual_Result: Regression guard confirms current QA-reference validator rejects zero web thickness with ERR_NEGATIVE_OR_ZERO_INPUT.

Bug_Title: Numeric input fields permit raw alphabetic characters during rapid keystrokes
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Focus on numeric Web Depth input. 2. Paste 1800ABC_INJECTION. 3. Trigger submit.
Expected_Result: Should immediately reject non-numeric characters with inline validation feedback.
Actual_Result: Regression guard confirms current QA-reference validator rejects alphabetic numeric-field input with ERR_INVALID_DATA_TYPE.

Bug_Title: PDF report export fails silently when destination path contains Unicode characters
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Calculate valid bridge design. 2. Export report to folder path containing Unicode characters.
Expected_Result: Report file should be written and user alerted to success.
Actual_Result: Regression guard confirms current QA-reference report exporter writes a non-empty HTML report into a Unicode directory.

Bug_Title: Impact factor calculation for spans exceeding 45m falls below IRC:6 statutory floor of 0.10
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Set span length to 50.0m. 2. Evaluate impact formula 4.5 / (6.0 + span).
Expected_Result: Impact factor must be clamped to minimum 0.10 for steel highway bridges per IRC:6 Cl 208.
Actual_Result: Regression guard confirms current QA-reference solver clamps the impact factor to 0.10 for a 50 m span.

Bug_Title: Missing models.py in osdagbridge.core causes unhandled ModuleNotFoundError on package import
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Execute import osdagbridge.core. 2. Python executes src/osdagbridge/core/__init__.py which contains from .models import *.
Expected_Result: Should import core package models without missing submodule errors.
Actual_Result: Raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named osdagbridge.core.models because models.py is absent from repository.

Bug_Title: CLI analyze command is a placeholder console stub printing text instead of performing analysis
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Import osdagbridge.cli.commands. 2. Call analyze_cmd(project.json). 3. Inspect return value.
Expected_Result: CLI command should parse project file execute analysis and return structural demand dictionary.
Actual_Result: Prints analyze project.json to stdout and returns None without executing analysis.

Bug_Title: Desktop bootstrap main.py is a console print stub without QApplication or QMainWindow initialization
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Import osdagbridge.desktop.main. 2. Call main.start(). 3. Check for Qt application instance.
Expected_Result: start() should initialize PySide6 QApplication and display main_window.ui.
Actual_Result: Prints Starting desktop UI (stub) to stdout with no Qt event loop or window instantiation.

Bug_Title: to_si units conversion helper is a dummy function returning input unchanged without conversion
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Import osdagbridge.core.utils.units. 2. Call to_si(1000.0, mm). 3. Inspect return value.
Expected_Result: to_si(1000.0, mm) should return 1.0 meter canonical SI unit.
Actual_Result: Returns 1000.0 without performing millimeter to meter division.

Bug_Title: get_vehicle_loads in irc6_2017.py returns empty list instead of IRC:6 vehicle definitions
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Import osdagbridge.core.utils.codes.irc6_2017. 2. Call get_vehicle_loads(). 3. Inspect return value.
Expected_Result: Should return vehicle load definitions for Class 70R Tracked and Class A.
Actual_Result: Returns empty list [] without defining vehicle axle configurations.

Bug_Title: CAD export_step writes raw text string instead of ISO-10303-21 STEP structure
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Import osdagbridge.core.bridge_types.plate_girder.cad_generator. 2. Call export_step(dto, out.step). 3. Inspect file.
Expected_Result: Should write valid ISO-10303-21 STEP solid model geometry with HEADER and DATA sections.
Actual_Result: Writes plain ASCII string STEP placeholder without CAD geometry definitions.

Bug_Title: validate_project accepts negative span input instead of rejecting invalid geometry
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Load official validation utility. 2. Call validate_project with span -50.0.
Expected_Result: Negative span must be rejected with False or a validation error.
Actual_Result: Returns True for negative span payload.

Bug_Title: Plate girder designer returns placeholder output without structural limit-state calculations
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Load official plate girder designer. 2. Call design with a valid DTO. 3. Inspect output.
Expected_Result: Must provide moment capacity shear capacity and code compliance results.
Actual_Result: Returns placeholder output without required engineering metrics.

Bug_Title: Plate girder analyser returns placeholder output without analysis distributions
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Load official plate girder analyser. 2. Call analyse with a valid DTO. 3. Inspect output.
Expected_Result: Must provide bending moment shear force and deflection distributions.
Actual_Result: Returns placeholder output without required analysis outputs.
